batting.dismissal: st KD Karthik b S Nadeem

balls.text: full toss outside off as he switches over the wicket. Goes for another swing but it came at him a little too quickly and he can only bunt it to long-off
Richardson, what are you doing?! Serving up length in the final over against a batsman who is timing it like a dream. Came forward and launched it straight over the bowler's head.
mighty strike through the covers! Jadhav is making a big case here for Delhi. This was almost a yorker and he had absolutely no room for the shot. Yet he opened the face and laced it through.

what a catch! Bhatia has picked up a sensational catch while skirting the long leg boundary! This was full and on leg stump and again sat up for Duminy to swing away. The fielder had to run to his right, had his eyes on it all the way and pouched it. But then he made sure he kept his balance. Faulkner was right beside him just in case he couldn't and needed assistance
length again and Duminy has mauled it over square leg. This is what he was looking for, one to swing that backlift clean through the line of the ball. This little partnership has reached 46 off 25
fires it seeking the block hole on middle, Doens't find it and Jadhav has punched it down to long-on
got under it and that helps him smash it down the ground. Long-on can only jog across and return the cherry back. Faulkner misses his length and JP was ready and waiting deep in his crease
down the track again and he flicks it off middle to deep midwicket
ends up low full toss just outside off as JP comes at him. Eased through to the sweeper
this was a good length, slower ball following him as he moved outside leg. The ball gets a kick off the turf after it hit the seam and it is chopped towards third man
skips down the track, turns the full delivery into a full toss and his timing is sit-up-on-your-chair-and-rub-your-eyes good! What a flick, deep midwicket had no chance
dot ball straight up. It's the slower one off the back of the hand, Jadhav was set up for the heave over cow corner, but he misses completely
length on the stumps and JP shuffles off side to cart it away to the square leg boundary. Extra ball bites
staying deep in the crease helps him punch an almost-yorker down to long-on. Gee, that was struck hard.
that's an easy one for the umpire. Slower ball slides down leg. Jadhav was walking across to pull over fine leg but can't reach
slower ball on the pads, clips to midwicket. JP had opened his stance that time
skips down the track while making room for himself, but his slice finds cover
looks for it again, but this time the cheekiness doesn't come off. It was shortish and on middle which probably hurt the execution

that's what he can do. He is such a clever striker at this time of the innings. It was short and angled across him. There was no slip (obviously) and JP opens the blade and uses the extra pace of the new bowler Richardson to tuck into an easy boundary to deep third man
that's a lovely delivery. Slower bouncer. Shades of Shaun Pollock there. JP adjusts well enough but still he can only pull it for a single through midwicket
shortish and outside off, Jadhav finds deep third man with a dab. Out in the dugout, Gary Kirsten is shuffling in his seat
full and wide again, JP has a long way to reach and steers it to deep point
full and angled into the pads, Jadhav glances it to long leg
another one with all the pace off it, shortish delivery chopped towards point

pushes it wide and JP reaches out and times this brilliantly! But the clinching factor was a little clumsiness from Richardson in the deep. Overruns the ball and lets it through his legs at deep cover
top-edged six! This looked even worse than DK's dismissal, but it went to a more fortunately-sized part of the ground. Lovely short ball from Faulkner again and Jadhav was quite late on his hook
shortish and outside off, steered to deep third man again. JP is playing the waiting game, but is he waiting a little too long?
slower ball off the back of the hand, he chops it to the right of the keeper for a single
greeted by a short ball and he ducks under it

holes out at deep square leg! Another crucial wicket at a crucial time for Royals. Dug in short and he chose to take it on. Hit high on the bat as he looked to pull. The man in the deep hardly had to move
back of a length and outside off, tapped behind towards third man
flicked off a good length to deep midwicket and they walk the single
nudged straight of midwicket to pick up a couple. Good use of the feet again. Oh, but look DK has not put his bat in while he was turning for the second
flights it on off stump, JP goes for the sweep but it turns and sneaks through. Deflects off his thigh and the keeper can't collect
goes deep in his crease as Tambe bowls this well behind the bowling crease. Ends up a little shortish and DK cuts to short third man
a little more flight on this and JP dances down the track and works it towards deep midwicket.
flighted on the stumps, driven nicely to long-on
this is the slower ball with a bit of width, JP spotted it but cuts straight to point.
walks across to pull it down to fine leg, but this one is a little quicker from Kulkarni. Decent height too, around the shoulders as he misses
shortish on middle, DK works it down to long leg
terrific stroke. Granted it was asking for it but JP had a long way to reach as he rocked back and cut through a diving backward point
back of a length on off stump, JP goes back and blocks towards midwicket
flicked off his toes as this was full and sliding down leg. Neatly done, bit finds the man in the deep
fullish on off stump, defended into the covers for a single
sought to ride the slower ball and dab it to third man for a single, but the legcutter bounces more and beats him. Well kept by Samson
seam up and DK has smashed it through the legs of the bowler. The virtue of a straight bat but it's Smith down there, races across from long-off and pulls it in
clipped towards the midwicket region as this slower ball was a little shortish in length
legcutter on the pads, DK eases it behind square leg
offcutter, driven down to long-off
fullish on off stump, DK pushes back to the bowler. Lovely straight bat
shortish and this time just outside off, JP is comfortable letting it run down his open face towards third man
on the pads, but JP can't pick it away off his hips
shortish on and around the stumps, blocked

wears it on the glove and scampers across for a single. It was a well directed short ball that seemed to climb on him. DK handled it well and the midwicket fielder just missed the bowler while hitting the stumps at the nonstrikers'
just back of a good length as he tucks Duminy up. Manages a little dab towards midwicket
shortish and JP works it off his hips towards midwicket
walks at him and blocks the short of a good length delivery towards mid-on. Direct hit at the bowlers' tempts DK towards a second, but he is sent back
fullish and DK races down the track to whip through midwicket. But the ball skews off the pads towards midwicket. Appeal from the bowler, but I think that pitched outside leg
fullish on off stump, he comes forward and blocks
shortish and JP rises with it and dabs it with short hands behind point
back of a length and outside off, Karthik opens the face to sneak a single through point

another one, Tambe, you legend! Looped it on off stump and De Kock could not resist. Went for a drive against the turn and the ball pitched just before his flaying blade, took the inside half of it and sat safely in the hands of the bowler himself. Tambe was pushed to the floor while taking the catch, but he had it under control
balls.dismissal: Q de Kock — caught and bowled

balls.text: flatter delivery on off stump, pushed down to long-on
flighted on leg, goes for the sweep but he can't hit it well enough. Single towards square leg

picks out long-on! This skewed off the inside half of the bat and it's Steven Smith down there. You know the rest of it. Tossed up and he looked to take it on. His timing fails him and this time the umps don't bother about the front-foot no-ball check
this is shortish and he cuts into the off side. Looked to hit it too hard
flighted on middle, nudged through the vacant midwicket region

short and wide and KP has muscled it to the right of the sweeper. He knew exactly where that man was as he sat and waited and then square drove it with a whip of his wrists. Daredevils have set up an excellent foundation here
legcutter with ample width, De Kock comes forward and slaps it to the sweeper
goes back to his variations as the offcutter is chopped to point
you beauty! Walks across and swipes this low full toss over the head of a diving short fine leg fielder. This was the seam-up delivery and whatever extra pace it had was utilised magnificently
do I even need to bother typing slower ball for this guy? Foils KP's timing thoroughly as the length ball is bunted to long-off
offcutter now, but its on the pads and De Kock tucks it away to square leg
swift turn for Tambe and KP was almost deceived. Looks ungainly as he cuts off the back foot. Almost lost his balance
take that. Comes forward and opens the face of the bat to smash this flighted ball through the covers. Magnificent footwork there as he stayed leg side to hit inside out
he's gotten away with that. It's a short ball spinning away too, KP rocks back to cut and gets a thick outside edge that almost reaches short third man
googly and this time he camps on his back foot having picked it and taps it through to deep cover
skips down the track and slices this through to the sweeper. Almost had to dig that out of the blockhole
tossed up on the pads, QDK nudges through to deep midwicket
took it from the stumps and cuts the slower ball straight to point. And he goes for the run! Desparing dive from De Kock (Yes, I liked saying that) but the throw doesn't find it's mark
long-off is back as KP leans forward to yet another legcutter and hits uppishly down the ground
fullish on the pads, De Kock nudges towards midwicket and the bowler himself has to race after it
another legcutter and this time KP trusts his straight bat and drives to long-on

legcutter and KP looks for a whip off the legs. Doesn't succeed in getting bat to it and then he looks for a cheeky single as the ball dribbles behind him. Samson rushed after it and hurled the throw and finds the target. The umps haven't referred it, but the replays show KP was way out. The Rajasthan dug out have sent the info out and Watson is having a heated conversation with the umps.
good length ball outside off, KP wades into a punch to cover
flighted on middle, De Kock drills it places it nicely between deep midwicket and long-on
think this was the wrong 'un. Tossed up on leg stump and QDK watchfully defends. Don't think he read it
this time off the back foot. He knew Tambe would pull his length back and he jumped back, made a little room outside leg and cuts past a diving point
loops it up but errs by giving a little room. De Kock lashes it through the covers. He seems pretty adept at getting those fuller balls away through the off side
flighted on off stump, De Kock pushes to the left of the bowler
skids on with the arm and KP has to hurry into a flick towards midwicket
more evidence for KP's form: the push down the ground and a hare across to the non-strikers'
fullish and just outside off, KP is punches to mid-off after a big move forward. That's usually a sign that he's feeling good
shortish and angled in at him, De Kock picks a single to deep square leg
fuller delivery on off stump, De Kock closes the face to mid-on
back of a length on middle, De Kock presents a dead bat

and produces magic straight away. Vijay looks to force the pace off a back of a good length delivery and has spooned a catch to mid-off. Would have done better to punch off the back foot, but Vijay is most comfortable pressing forward. Went through with the shot and the bat face turned on impact. Ends up a simple catch after Watson called mine
that must have geed Watson up. Fires in a 136k fuller ball outside off. De Kock allows it through to the keeper. Was a little too outside leg to reach
this has gone all the way! QDK on fire. Full and outside off but he skips across outside off and flicks it away. All the way.
slightly slower this time so Vijay has to wait on it but still flicks it handsomely to deep midwicket
they're not bothering with the off side much. This was full and angling across the batsman, but De Kock pushed forward and his fast hands pull off a whip to deep midwicket
full and wide outside off, De Kock drives into the covers but hasnt timed it

floats a fuller ball, Vijay takes it from outside off and those wrists come into picture again. Lovely timing meant the fielder at deep midwicket had a lot of ground to cover and needed a full-length dive as well
plants his front leg across on off stump and swiped it to the long leg boundary. That's 2000 runs in T20 cricket for QDK. Well done to him, especially in spotting that slower ball
this was the slower delivery pushed wide outside off. De Kock slashes and misses
picks this off off stump and flicks it to deep square leg. Why bother with the covers when you have wrists like that
goes fuller and the shape away gains a little more potency. Vijay is forward and gets it off the outside half of the bat towards cover
back of a length on off stump, Vijay tries a shuffle but then taps to mid-on
full and tailing in on leg stump, clips through square leg
sends in a short one just outside off, soars past a swaying Vijay and the keeper has to leap as high as he could go to pull that in
this time the length is a little fuller and de Kock nudges it through midwicket off the back foot
back of a length on and around off stump, de Kock looks to close his bat a little too early and gets an outside edge towards cover
opens the face that time as he preempts the bowler would go shorter. Stays back in his crease and finds third man
offers room and it was a half volley as well, Vijay leans into a gorgeous cover drive. Had no troubles at all
just back of a length on middle and leg, tucked away in front of square leg
whipped through to deep midwicket. This was fuller but the line was on the pads, easy put away for de Kock
and even as I say that he bowls a full toss on leg stump and Vijay tucks it behind square leg
far more tentative is Vijay as a back of a length delivery shapes away. Gets a thick outside edge down to third man. I get the feeling Binny likes a right-hander better
little inward drift and de Kock clips the good length ball towards midwicket
drilled through point! Sought the blockhole, but de Kock came forward with an open face and the square drive was even better struck
invites him forward with a fuller delivery outside off and de Kock times it nicely to mid-off
slower ball ends up a full toss which Karun smashes over point and that seals the game
seeks the yorker on middle, Karun nudged towards midwicket and the captain at the other end just set off. The fielder takes aim and sends in the throw, but it misses. Watson was miles out
slower ball in the slot and Karun has launched it over cover. One-bounce four brings the scores level
length and it sat up for Watson to maul over midwicket. If he was looking for revenge, that was it

came on the front foot and slaps it towards point. Though there was a run in it but he is sent back by the non-striker. Rightly too and a desperate dive seems to have saved him. Kedar Jadhav had a stump or so to aim at and he nailed it. Excellent work

fullish on middle, Watson punches it back at the bowler who hurls it at the stumps. Watson was taking evasive action and finds himself on the floor. Parnell apologises, but Watson doesn't seem like he takes too kindly to unnecessary projectiles hurled at him
back of a length and outside off, defended into the off side for a quick single

shortish and just enough outside off for Karun to flick those wrists and cut it past the keeper. Third man was too square to stop that and Karun placed it brillliantly. One point his strike rate was well below 100 and it's 140 almost
thick outside edge flies to deep third man as Parnell goes full and outside off

these slower balls are sitting up for him. It's no longer a surprise when you bowl it through the over and Karun set himself up to hit over the top through the off side. Mid-off runs back and pulls it in
length and Karun has slapped it over long-on. Came forward out of his crease and belted it over the top
back of a length, punched to short cover. Daredevils are scrapping the bottom of their plans bucket
seam-up this time and Nair moves outside leg to drill the full delivery to long-off
good length ball on middle and off, he steps forward and blocks. Again, slower ball
back of a length and outside off, Karun clipes it through midwicket and picks up a couple that gets him past a half-century. Pace off the ball doesn't bother him
down the pitch again, but the bowler drags his length ball and pushes the ball a little outside off as well. Watson was looking long-on again and adjusts a flick of the wrists
on a good length on off stump, defended off the back foot
doesn't bother him as he keeps tossing the ball up. Lures him forward and gets a bit of an outside edge
skips down the track and Watson has picked this up and dropped it over long-on. Nadeem's flight backfires on him that time
presses forward but once he sees it isn't in his half, he is quick to rock back and cuts behind point. Lovely shot
flighted outside off, Karun leans forward and drives to long-off

there we go, the offcutter has flattened off stump! Bhatia saw length and went for a slog, But he hasn't spotted the variation, which grips the pitch and darts back in to hit timber. Is this the start of something?
cramps him up with a short of a good length delivery on off stump, he pulls through midwicket awkwardly
shortish and outside off, Karun taps it to point
on a length and Bhatia swings it away to deep square leg
this is the slower bouncer and Karun has spotted it and dabs it to deep third man
142kph, just short of a good length and Bhatia seems hurried as he pulls and has to fling the top hand off his bat. Single to deep square leg
and on the other end of the other V. Parnell strays on the pads with a short length ball which is calmly glanced away. That will be the time out
that was what he practiced the last time he played and missed and it pays off. Lovely hands from Karun as he picks a good length ball from off stump and late cut it to the third man boundary
short-armed pull towards deep midwicket as Parnell pushes the batsman back again
shortish and he's lofted it into the midwicket region
a little too full for the cut and Karun walks over towards square leg to admonish himself. Another dot ball for him
shortish on middle, Bhatia pulls to deep square leg
goes short but this has a little too much steam on it. Sails over the batsman's head while he was almost upright as he let it go
walks across and cuts it to the boundary behind point. Rahul Sharma's inclusion is backfiring on all cylinders. This was short and handed the batsman width. Karun accepted with glee
flighted on off stump, Bhatia drills it to long-on
quicker, shorter and flatter. Bhatia camped on his back foot and pulls wide of long-on. It was well struck and Duminy had to get the skates on
but this has been struck cleanly! Raced down the track again and gets under this flighted ball to send it soaring over long-on

Duminy was backtracking at long-on and he reaches one hand out ahead of him to try and grab it. The swirler though evades him. Excellent effort from him. Tossed up and Bhatia ran down the track and swung with all his might. Got more height than distance there though

that's a shocking ball and Bhatia has produced an even worse shot. banged into the middle of the pitch and it was meant to go sailing out of the ground. Instead Bhatia has tried to slog it too hard and bunts it back to the bowler

this is back of a length and he backs away and heaves it over the top. Gets a lot of height and I was expecting someone to be under it, but it's got enough on it to reach the extra cover boundary. Just checking if it is a six or a four now. It's terribly tight. Judgement call this and it's a six
steps down the track and swipes at the slower bouncer with the top hand off the bat. Single to deep midwicket
goes for another late cut but this slower ball is a little too close. Beaten
back of a good length and he's taken the pace off again, blocked with an open face behind point
another guide down to third man off a slower ball
starts off with a change of pace, which is no surprise to the batsman who waits on it and cuts it late down to third man
good length ball outside off, comes forward and looks to smash it over the off side. Gets a thick inside edge that wanders away to deep square leg
full on middle, Karun has timed it nicely through midwicket. Long-on gets a work out
goes wide of the crease and Karun swings wildly. Goes for a pull and gets an inside edge that bounces on its way to the keeper
on a length and he backs away and slaps it down the ground. Comes off the bottom of the bat though
141kph, short of a length and whizzing through to the keeper as the batsman lets it go
good length ball just outside off, he stays back and blocks

tossed up and outside off, Samson reaches out to lash it through the covers. Misses and his momentum ruins his balance. The keeper waits on the back foot to lift and then whips off the bails. Promising innings cut short
flighted on the stumps and he has slapped it straight over the bowler's head. Good shot
teases him on middle and he lets it go
moves to off stump and blocks this flighted ball down the pitch. It's the time out now
flighted on middle, nudged down to long-on
magnificent! Saw it tossed up and leaned forward and stayed beside the ball and launched it over extra cover
walks across to off stump and defends into the covers. Nadeem is the man there and in his haste to throw ball, he hits it into the turf right by his feet
shortish and just a shade outside off, Samson stays leg side of it and slaps it through to the sweeper
good length ball just outside off, he taps it down the ground with a straight bat
comes forward and pushes the length ball through to the sweeper
goes back as this is on a good length and taps it down to long-on
driven down the ground calmly for a single
beauty! This one grips and turns and beats Samson's front foot push. The perfect length to lure the batsman forward but he still had his back leg in his crease
tosses the arm ball up outside off, Samson leans into a square drive and Parnell had to pull out a slide on the boundary to keep it in the field of play
goes back and dabs the good length ball into the covers
walks forward and nudges the flighted delivery from off stump down to long-on
on a good length on off stump, he stands up tall and punches it back at the bowler
much better. Bit of flight and drift on off stump as the batsman strides forward and pushes to long-off
that's a terrific stroke. Went deep in his crease and used the pace of the flatter ball and late cuts it past the short third man
walks across to off stump as the bowler is in his delivery stride, Samson steers it towards short third man

starts off with a short one outside off, Samson slaps it through to the keeper for a couple. The throw comes in and a dive seems to have saved Samson by miles but the umps will go up for the replay. Better safe than sorry
back of a length and angled across him, Samson runs it down to third man on the boundary
opens the face and runs the short of a good length ball to point
back of a length on leg stump as he hopes to cramp him up, succeeds as Samson blocks down the pitch
fullish on middle and off, this time Samson was right in getting forward and a clean swing of the arms down the line sends the ball clattering into the crowd straight down the ground

140kph, falls short of mid-off. Samson was looking for a flick through midwicket and it was off the front foot again. Ends up with a leading edge because this ball was too short for the shot. And there was a run-out chance as well at the non-strikers'
shortish and on the stumps, makes Samson rise up on his toes to block down the pitch
a little slower again around the off stump, dabbed into the third man region
slower ball outside off, chopped behind point for a quick single
144kph, dug in, just outside off. He's rooted to the crease and pushes at it with his hands. Somehow manages to keep it down

goes for a front foot pull and it lobs up in the air. Manages to get enough bat on it to land safely in the midwicket region. Good short ball from Shami as he made sure the batsman had to fetch it from off stump
a little close for the cut but he goes for it still. It was just short of a length and in the corridor, a wristy flick gets it down to third man
back of a length and just outside off, defended down the pitch. That was pacy
picked off his legs, that should keep Unadkat to a better line. Especially when he's beating the batsmen outside off. Fast hands and brilliant timing from Samson
this good length ball seems to have held in the pitch judging by Samson having to pull his top hand off the bat while pushing into the off side.
shortish and on the pads again, tucked away through square leg
gorgeous! This was fuller as he slanted it across the right hander, who pushes forward with an open face and is beaten by the away seam
he's getting the ball to zip nicely, but his line is on the pads. Karun goes for another nurdle to try and beat short fine leg but can't connect.
beauty! Drew him into chasing at a back of a length delivery that darted away after pitching. Karun was beaten all ends up there

they're struggling with their line here. This was back of a length and goes down leg. Karun looks to glance it and misses. But the bowler and the fielders are quite interested in this. Keeper wasn't though
just short of a good length on middle, Samson the new batsman, is right behind it
146kph, shortish, but his search for pace is luring his lines to go wrong.

how bout that! M Vijay has pulled off a screamer and took a leaf out of Dwayne Bravo's book and did a little jig. This was fuller and teasing him outside off, Rahane got forward and timed his cover drive quite well. Only he didn't keep it down. Vijay dives to his left and plucks out a low one
short ball, sat up for him and Rahane put it away with the minimum of fuss. Didn't bother keeping it down because he knew fine leg was up in the circle
guided to deep third man as Parnell goes fishing outside off stump. That was at 146kph!
144kph, good length ball just outside off, Nair leans into a push through the covers. Rahane was looking for a single but had to be sent back.
144kph, shortish and on the hips, Rahane nudges it to short fine leg
back of a length and just outside off, defended
digs it into the middle of the pitch at 142kph, it was outside off so the batsman sways inside the line
angles it into the other opener and Karun has clipped it smartly to the midwicket boundary. Nicely controlled
fullish and shaping away, Rahane was a little early into his drive through the covers and settles for a single off an inside edge straight of midwicket
tightens up on the corridor as Rahane blocks the back of a length delivery down the pitch
little bit of shape but it only helps Rahane as he caresses the good length delivery through the covers. Just enough room to free the arms but it wasn't hit at all hard
pushed through on the pads and Rahane picks it through to deep square leg
flighted on off stump, comes forward and blocks
holds into the pitch a little and Karun benefits by presenting a straight bat. Single to long-on
goes on with the arm with a fuller delivery, Rahane calmly tucks it into midwicket
tossed up on middle and Karun displays an awkward sweep to deep square leg
flighted but drifting down, Rahane lunges forward and sweeps to the right of short fine leg
